dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: Our drink recommendations? Well, for starters, I recommend you drink less!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A waiter who tries to convince the customers not to spend...

dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's how you know to trust my recommendation! And, I happen to have another one — why don't you try some of our food and soft drinks? I swear you won't regret it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Won't you get in trouble if your boss finds out?

dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: Quite the opposite! Drunk customers tend to give off a funky smell, not to mention, they turn violent easily. The last thing we want is bar stools and beer bottles flying around the place!

dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: Good employees like me are always thinking ahead, so we can save the boss some trouble down the line. Wouldn't you agree?

dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: Suit yourself! If you change your mind, just let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any reliable intel?

dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: Oh, you're that sort of customer... I'm afraid you're not going to get much from me. I mean, who goes around leaking important details to waiters? Now gossip, on the other hand...

dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: You see that young man over there with the brown hair? That's right, the treasure hunter. He's actually — dum dum dum — the son of Speranza's boss!

dialogues.speaker: Paavo
dialogues.text: Is that the sort of gossip you're after? Because I've got loads more where that came from! But gossip really is more of an after-dinner indulgence, if you catch my drift...
